Baltimore hasn’t had the same home price bump as other
In home sales data since 2000 taken from the same zip code as a MLB stadium, Baltimore’s
rate of median price growth lags far behind much of the league. But it has exceeded the
rate of other small market cities.
BY MATT COHEN | CAPITAL NEWS SERVICE
